name: Tower of Azora
summary: At the Tower of Azora, Archmage Theocritus leads a scholarly outpost in eastern Elwynn Forest. The slender spire stands north of the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch, where its human master keeps watch over a silent magical feud with a hostile tower in the Redridge Mountains.

sections.title: A Spire of Arcane Vigilance
sections.body: The Tower of Azora stands beside the eastern road to the Redridge Mountains, staffed almost entirely by gnome spellcasters. Archmage Theocritus guides their studies of strange curiosities and teaches wandering spellweavers. A wild magical aura surrounds the spire and sometimes warps nearby wildlife. Within the tower, gnome servants contend with enchanted household items and mutated insects that creep past the doorway.

sections.title: The Feud with Ilgalar
sections.body: The Tower of Azora wages a quiet war of scrying and sabotage. Eastward, atop the crags of the Redridge Mountains, the sinister Tower of Ilgalar is ruled by the renegade sorcerer Morganth. Theocritus and Morganth spy on one another through arcane means. They enlist daring adventurers to plant scrying relics such as the Eye of Azora, piercing Ilgalar's wards to watch Morganth's dark machinations.

faq.q: Who rules the Tower of Azora?
aliases: who leads the tower of azora
faq.answer: Archmage Theocritus, an accomplished human wizard, presides over the Tower of Azora. He directs its servants and coordinates the tower's magical defenses against rival sorcerers.

faq.q: Why are there so many gnomes here?
faq.answer: Most servants at the Tower of Azora are gnome researchers and acolytes. They help Archmage Theocritus with his studies, arcane experiments, and housekeeping when magic goes awry.

faq.q: Who is the tower fighting against?
faq.answer: The Tower of Azora is locked in a magical rivalry with the Tower of Ilgalar in the Redridge Mountains, home to the evil sorcerer Morganth. Both towers spy on each other with scrying artifacts and contest each other's influence.

faq.q: What is the Eye of Azora on the top floor?
faq.answer: The Eye of Azora is an enchanted scrying focus on a table in the upper sanctum. Touching it lets an observer gaze across magical distance and watch the outskirts of the Tower of Ilgalar.

angles.text: As a mage traveling beyond Stormwind, you can find a secluded place to study, arcane trainers, and a close view of the dangerous arts of remote divination at the tower.
As a gnome, you can take pride in seeing an arcane spire in human lands staffed by gnomes under Archmage Theocritus, a showcase of your people's mastery of the mystic arts.
